verdict.rationale: Vapi's HIPAA docs describe an organization-wide compliance mode that lets you control how call recordings and logs are stored, toggled from the Dashboard. That is real but indirect support for retention control. Transient (inline) configurations offer a way to avoid persisting assistant configs, but nothing documents explicit deletion of calls or data. Missing for 10: explicit retention-period settings, documented deletion of calls/recordings/transcripts via API or CLI, data-deletion request handling, independent corroboration.
